description: The Lexar Professional SILVER PRO 128GB SDXC UHS-II Memory Card is designed for photographers, videographers and content creators who need high-speed and reliable storage for professional cameras. With read speeds of up to 280MB/s and write speeds of up to 120MB/s, this high-performance SD card helps accelerate file transfers and capture workflows when used with compatible UHS-II devices. The V60 Video Speed Class rating makes it suitable for high-quality 1080p Full-HD and 4K video recording on compatible cameras. The 128GB capacity provides ample space for photos, videos and other digital content. The card uses the SDXC UHS-II format and is suitable for compatible DSLR cameras, mirrorless cameras, digital cameras and other SDXC-enabled devices. It is also backward compatible with UHS-I devices, although maximum UHS-II performance requires a compatible UHS-II host device and reader. Ideal for professional photography, 4K video recording, content creation, file transfer and everyday camera storage.
